content.title: Oklo & other nuclear stocks climb, Public Storage upgraded
content.description:
Yahoo Finance anchor Josh Lipton tracks Monday's top moving stocks and biggest market stories in this Market Minute.

Nuclear stocks, including Oklo (OKLO), NuScale Power (SMR), and Nano Nuclear Energy (NNE), are rising.

Beyond Meat (BYND) stock continues to nosedive after the company's bond investors accepted a debt swap to dilute shares.

Public Storage (PSA) was upgraded to Buy from Hold by Deutsche Bank.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.

content.title: Beyond Meat Plummets After Debt Swap Massively Dilutes Shareholders
content.summary: While the the debt swap may give the company some “breathing room” by reducing leverage and extending the maturity of its debt, the shareholder dilution is “pretty substantial,” said Bloomberg Intelligence’s Jennifer Bartashus.  Beyond Meat exploded after its public debut six years ago, with the company once valued at over $14 billion.  Brands Inc.’s KFC, experimented with plant-based offerings to attract those looking to cut back on meat consumption.

content.title: Why Beyond Meat (BYND) Stock Is Falling Today
content.summary: Shares of plant-based protein company Beyond Meat (NASDAQ:BYND) fell 47.1% in the afternoon session after the company announced the early settlement of a debt exchange offer that will lead to a massive issuance of new stock, significantly diluting the value for existing shareholders.
